# Drugs.com

> Comprehensive medication reference and health information platform providing drug details, interactions, side effects, and condition-specific treatment options.

Drugs.com serves as a trusted resource for patients and healthcare providers seeking detailed pharmaceutical information, drug interaction checking, and medical procedure guidance. The site aggregates medication data across multiple therapeutic categories including contraceptives, antibiotics, and specialty treatments.

## Drug Information & References

- [Ortho Micronor: Indications, Side Effects, Warnings](https://failover.drugs.com/cdi/ortho-micronor.html): Comprehensive drug information page for Ortho Micronor contraceptive including indications, side effects, and safety warnings.
- [Acetaminophen, Pheniramine, and Phenylephrine Uses, Side Effects & Warnings](https://failover.drugs.com/mtm/acetaminophen-pheniramine-and-phenylephrine.html): Detailed medication information for this combination cold remedy including usage guidelines, side effects, and contraindications.

## Drug Interaction Checker

- [Bedaquiline Interactions Checker](https://failover.drugs.com/drug-interactions/bedaquiline.html): Interactive drug interaction checker tool for Bedaquiline with 587 known medication interactions and safety alerts.

## Condition & Treatment Guides

- [Helicobacter Pylori Infection Medications Compared](https://failover.drugs.com/condition/helicobacter-pylori-infection.html): Comprehensive medication comparison list for Helicobacter Pylori infection treatment with 47 medication options and user ratings.

## Medical Procedures & Health Guides

- [Lymph Node Biopsy Guide: Causes, Symptoms and Treatment Options](https://failover.drugs.com/health-guide/lymph-node-biopsy.html): Comprehensive health guide covering lymph node biopsy procedures, diagnostic criteria, preparation, and treatment options.
